StudioSession.title: StudioSession
StudioSession.description: A persistent music production studio session with live DSP mix parameters and key/BPM configuration.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Producer who owns this session.

title.description: Title of the track or studio session.

musicalKey.description: Musical key of the track (e.g., C minor).

grooveStyle.description: Active rhythmic pocket style for the sequencer and stem synthesizer.

hpfHz.description: Surgical high-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz (20 to 220).

eqLowDb.description: Low shelf EQ gain at 80 Hz in dB (-12.0 to 12.0).

eqMidHz.description: Parametric mid EQ center frequency in Hz (250 to 5000).

eqMidDb.description: Parametric mid EQ gain in dB (-12.0 to 12.0).

eqHighDb.description: High shelf air EQ gain at 9 kHz in dB (-12.0 to 12.0).

compThresholdDb.description: Dynamic range compressor threshold in dB (-40.0 to 0.0).

saturation.description: Analog harmonic saturation drive amount (0.0 to 1.0).

lastSpark.description: Most recent producer spark or summary for display in the session vault.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StudioMessage.title: StudioMessage
StudioMessage.description: A single conversational turn in the unified 3-agent studio thread (Producer, Sound Engineer, or AI Lyricist).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

speaker.description: Participant speaker tag in the studio chat.

text.description: Spoken/written studio message, mix breakdown, or lyrics.

sampleCredit.description: Explicit Sample Transparency credit (Artist - Track) if referencing or flipping existing music.

stemPackIncluded.description: Whether this turn includes an inline playable/downloadable multi-stem WAV card.

stemBpm.description: BPM snapshot associated with the inline stem pack.

stemKey.description: Musical key snapshot associated with the inline stem pack.

stemGroove.description: Groove style snapshot associated with the inline stem pack.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-owned music production sessions and DSP console states.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/mes.description: Ordered 3-participant studio conversation and inline stem pack records.
